items.stem: A client's investment policy statement specifies a liability to be funded in 10 years. The most appropriate allocation approach is:

options.rationale: Correct: funding a defined liability calls for a liability-relative approach.

options.text: Equal weighting across all asset classes
options.rationale: Naive equal weighting ignores the liability structure.
A single-period return focus ignores the liability horizon.
All-cash likely fails to fund a growing liability.

items.explanation: Correct: funding a defined liability calls for a liability-relative approach.

items.stem: Under the Standards, when managing a pooled fund, an advisor must treat soft-dollar benefits as:

options.text: Belonging to the clients and used for their benefit
options.rationale: Correct: soft dollars belong to clients and must be used for their benefit.
Soft dollars are not the advisor’s to keep.
Use of client brokerage must be disclosed.

items.explanation: Correct: soft dollars belong to clients and must be used for their benefit.

items.stem: Which TWO are valid components of a performance attribution for an equity portfolio? (Select TWO)

options.rationale: Correct: allocation effect is a standard attribution component.
Correct: selection effect is a standard attribution component.
Marketing spend is not a return-attribution component.

items.explanation: Correct: allocation effect is a standard attribution component.
